name: numeric-above-safe-integer-rejected
description: An integer literal equal to 2^53, one past I-JSON's safely representable integer bound of 2^53-1, is refused as number_out_of_range -- distinct from numeric-out-of-range-rejected, which only tests the far larger double-overflow threshold.
notes: 9007199254740992 is 2^53, one past 2^53-1 (Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER), the bound the number_out_of_range category's own definition already names. Distinct literals above this bound collapse to fewer distinct IEEE-754 doubles than there are literals, so accepting them would break the injectivity of literal to id.
